title: File:Sapa view 3.jpg
claims: The photograph looks down over steep, closely spaced rice terraces near Sa Pa, with two small farm buildings, footpaths and wooded gullies between the fields; the file's Flickr source and EXIF title identify the location as Topas Ecolodge, but the frame does not show the lodge buildings, the finish gantry or any race furniture.

Commons titles the file Sapa view 3.jpg; the description reads 'Sa Pa, Vietnam' and the source line reads Flickr: Topas Ecolodge; the route page uses it as terraced-landscape context near the Topas Ecolodge finish, not as proof of the finish line, the final descent or race-day conditions.

The author is David McKelvey; the file is licensed CC BY 2.0; the photograph was taken on 2010-08-31 at 18:01:24; the original is 3,216 x 1,809 pixels and 2.42 MB; the file page gives no camera coordinates.
The route page uses a 960 x 540 copy of 248,916 bytes without cropping or colour change and credits David McKelvey, CC BY 2.0, Wikimedia Commons; the resized copy keeps the same licence.
